lamps.steady: Parking brake is engaged, brake fluid is low, or there is a brake system malfunction. Stop safely and check brakes.

lamps.lamp: Driver’s Seat Belt Reminder Light / Front Passenger’s Seat Belt Reminder Light
lamps.steady: The driver or front passenger seat belt is not buckled.

lamps.lamp: Rear Seat Passenger's Seat Belt Reminder Light
lamps.steady: One or more rear seat passenger seat belts are unbuckled.
There is a problem with the airbag system. Have it inspected by an authorized workshop.
Fuel level is low. Refill the fuel tank immediately.
There is a problem with the ABS system. Have it inspected by an authorized workshop.

lamps.lamp: High Engine Coolant Temperature Warning Light
lamps.steady: The engine is overheating. Stop the vehicle safely and turn off the engine immediately.
lamps.flashing: The engine is running hot. Stop safely to avoid overheating.

lamps.steady: There is a malfunction in the emission control or automatic transmission system. Have it inspected.
lamps.flashing: Engine misfire detected. Stop immediately in a safe place to avoid catalyst damage.

lamps.steady: There is a problem with the electric power steering system. Have it inspected.
Engine oil pressure is too low. Stop the engine immediately.
There is a problem with the battery charging system. Have it inspected immediately.

lamps.lamp: Immobilizer/Keyless Push Start System Warning Light
lamps.steady: There is a system problem or the remote controller is not inside the vehicle.
lamps.flashing: There is a system problem, or the remote controller is missing. The engine will not start.

lamps.steady: One or more doors, including the tailgate, are open.
